args.text: You saw some of the places Colt visited while on his journey... But they weren't the only ones!
Check out a few of the other Centerscore alums he ran into!
At a skate park in Central Valley, California...
So you mostly just hang out here, skating?
Well, I'm `technically` a student, so I go to class every once in a while... You know, like one a week or so...
What can I say? That's college!
Heh! That's awesome, man!
How about that hipster filmmaker girl you were with? You stay in touch with her?
Mallika? The two of us are still together!
Isn't she in, like, Nepal?
She's off in Norway studying at Oxfjord, where she spends, like, 20 hours a day in class or doing homework...
But we still find time to videochat...
You're actually making the long-distance thing work... That's crazy. Awesome... But crazy.
Who knew, right?
And on the football field of Centerscore University...
So, you should know, I don't really know much about football...

Oh, that's fine! The situation is... We've got a big game next week against Shanktown State. And they have a reputation for playing really dirty. Fouls, penalties, whatever... Once, one of their players brought a live beehive onto the field and threw it in the middle of the game!
The problem is, the guys on the team here aren't used to that sort of thing... And we tend to get crushed!
Using practice dummies and roleplay isn't enough. What I need is a real, live `shady` person they can use as a model to learn their tackles!
I'm going to act like myself and let a bunch of college football players tackle me?
That is correct, yes.
Just think about the paycheck, Colt. Think about the paycheck...
And at a small coffee shop in Santa Cruz...
Thanks so much for meeting us!
We really appreciate it!
Sure, right... But what am I doing here again?
Well, we're at the National Impromptu Dark Poetry Finals...
But the problem is, we've run out of angsty ideas!
It's possible that we've mined to the very bottoms of our personal wells of sadness and ennui!
Is that, like, a skin disease?
What we need is a fresh injection of angst into our collective poetic pool... A whole new mine of darkness we can tap!
I don't know if I'm the right guy... I mean, I don't think I've ever actually read a poem that wasn't a dirty limerick...
Well, just humor me here. Why are you on the road?
Oh, well, it's just... I had to go because I kept hurting the people I loved the most, and I just couldn't bear it any more.
Dinah and Raven stop and look at each other excitedly.
Go on...
In a tattoo parlor in Phoenix...
Now, you're sure this is what you want?
Yup.
And just to make sure we're on the same page... We're talking about an adorable kitten on your left shoulderblade.
It's a spirit animal thing. You wouldn't understand.
And in an auto repair shop in New Mexico...
Hello? I have a delivery here...
There is the clatter of tools from the corner. A figure steps out...
That would be... Mine...
`AGGGGGGGH!` You again! Why?! Why do you exist?
Colt throws the delivery and runs out.
No tip... For... That guy!
Running into Mr. Doom is no joke... But compared to what Colt's about to encounter in San Francisco, it's a walk in the park!

You're right. I hate to say it, but you're right.
I can't just keep running. And I `can't` let that Hawk guy get away with treating us like that!
Exactly! No one makes a fool of Tom Prince... And no one makes a fool of Colt Poorguy!
My last name is Warren.
It was a reasonable guess.
Now what do you want to do? Challenge him to another race? Steal his car? Lock him in a shipping container and send him to Eastern Europe?
No... I've got an even better idea...
He said he was having a slope dedicated to him, right? Probably gonna be some kind of a media event?
Probably.
Colt takes out his cell phone and dials a number...
Hello?
Blondie! It's me!
Well, well! Good to hear from you, Colt! What do you want?
What do `you` want?
Just hear me out, okay? I know I kind of messed up when I punched that old weirdo in the face...
He's not a weirdo!
But right now, I really, `really` need your help. One Centerscore Grad to another?
...Ugh. What is it?
You worked on that one movie with Hawk Gunner, right?
Hawk? I `hate` that guy! Talk about an ego!
He hit on me `seventeen times` after I told him I had a boyfriend!
You got any good dirt on him?
Well... Now that you mention it... I do have this one video clip...
Later that night... Hawk stands in front of a large, assembled crowd at the top of a brand new ski slope, named 'The A-Hawk-alypse!'
Hello all! You do me the great honor of dedicating this slope to my name!
I will take the honorary first snowboard down to open it to the public...
But first... Let's enjoy three and a half hours of my greatest ski tricks!
A projector whirrs to life and begins playing footage of Hawk on a large screen. He zips down the slopes... Spins... Does flips...
What poise! What grace! What dashing good looks!
Meanwhile, in a grove on the far side of the crowd, Colt and Tom hide behind a pair of trees...
So you have the video?
Colt holds a small USB thumb drive.
Yep! And let me tell you, it's a doozy...
Now we just need to get to that projector and plug it in...
Only one problem with that...
Two of Hawk's bros stand in front of the projector, their arms folded over their chests.
I suppose that's `two` problems...
Okay. No big deal. `Classic` caper.
One of us causes a distraction to get them away from the projector... And the other one sneaks up and plugs in the drive!
One of us? I thought Jeeves would do it.
Your butler? But he's not even...
A bush near the two of them rustles, and Jeeves pops out!
Good evening, sirs. I believe you need my assistance?
Aggggh! What?! When did he get here?
I called him as soon as we decided to do the prank! Jeeves is actually pretty good at this sort of thing.
I don't know, man... Doesn't feel right to have some senior citizen doing our work for us...
That's the whole point of a butler!
Yeah, well, I don't like having a butler!
Colt looks back out to the clearing. The two bros stand in the exact same spots.
Okay, okay...
Make your choice!
I'll do it.|Jeeves can do it.
What do you say?
All right, old-timer... Let's see what you've got.
Ahem, ahem...
Jeeves clears his throat and steps forward.
Ahoy! Good gentlemen! I come bearing important tidings!
A bus full of damsels has run aground not a mile hence... And they need the immediate assistance of two strapping males!
...Damsels?
...Assistance?
Yes! They were buxom, flaxen-haired maidens, wearing matching uniforms. I do believe their bus said something about the 'California Cheerleading Finals.'
Cheerleaders?!
`Flaxen?!`
Well, if you'd like to help them, I do recommend you be on your way. They won't need help for all that much longer...
Dude! We gotta go!
Wait! What about the projector? Hawk said we couldn't abandon the projector!
I will man your post, good sirs. I can assure you that I will keep the closest of guard on it.
Cool! You're old and have an accent, which means we can trust you!
Let's go help some babes!
The two bros scamper off, high-fiving each other. Colt and Tom emerge from the woods.
I gotta hand it to you, Gramps... That was some top-notch work.
A ruffian is a ruffian, young sir, whether he's a cutpurse in Beijing or a hooligan in Liverpool.
I don't understand a word you just said.
Now then, if you don't mind, I'd like to follow those two gentlemen to make sure they don't double back.
Jeeves takes off after the bros, vanishing into the brush.
Man, that guy is really sneaky...
Eh, he's all right. Now come on! Let's get this video playing!
Are you sure, sir? I was trained in Her Majesty's Service in over forty-five forms of deception and combat...
Yeah, and if I need any help jousting on horseback, I'll make sure to call. But this right here is the kind of thing I was born for.
As you will, young ruffian.
Colt shoots Jeeves a sidelong glance, then bends down and packs a firm snowball.
Okay, Tom, get ready. I'm gonna hurl this at them, then run. When they take off after me, you run up and jam the flash drive in! Got that
Got it.
Colt lines up his shot... Winds... And throws!
The snowball whistles through the air and nails one of the bros in the face!
Jackpot!
`Aggggh!` Snow in my mouth! Snow in my mouth!
Someone just threw snow in my mouth!
The bro walks forward... But the other one stops him!
No! Hawk told us not to leave the projector for any reason... And that includes awesome-fun snowball fights!
He did?
The bro takes out some instructions out of his pocket and reads them...
'Do not leave the projector for any reason, and that includes awesome-fun snowball fights!'
Hawk's so smart... I'm glad I'm his bro!
Me too!
Ugh! These guys are the worst!
Oh, for Pete's sake...
Tom steps forward, leaving the cover of the trees!
Hey! You two!
I'll pay you a hundred bucks each to abandon your posts!
The two bros look at each other...
Awesome! Money's great!
I like how you can spend it to get stuff!
Tom hands each bro a crisp, hundred dollar bill. They scamper off, hooting.
Wow.
See? Piece of cake.
Truly exemplary bribing, sir. May I have your permission to follow them and make sure they don't come back?
Absolutely!
Jeeves takes off after the bros, vanishing into the brush.
Tom and Colt walk up to the projector. Up front, Hawk is preening and strutting in front of the video of himself. Colt plugs in the thumb drive.
Wanna do the honors?
My pleasure.
Tom presses the 'Switch Inputs' button. The video at the front flickers for a moment...
Huh? What's happening?
Then a grainy old home movie comes on! It depicts a living room.
A title card is shoved in front of the screen. It reads '`The Space-ventures of Captain Handsome.`'
'Written, Directed By, And Starring `Hawkothy Orville Gunner!'`
No... It can't be...
Hawkothy?
I know, right?
The title card is pulled away... And a thirteen-year-old Hawk appears! He faces the camera and speaks in a squeaky, high-pitched voice...
Well, well, well. If it isn't my old nemesis, Emperor Nefario! You really thought you would get away with a dastardly plot to steal all of the princesses in the galaxy!
The camera swings around to reveal a very poorly made cardboard cutout of a space emperor. When it swings back, Hawk is holding a mop!
Well, I'm here to stop you... With my `outer space martial arts!` Please watch, space princesses! I'm space taking him space down!
Young Hawk lunges forward, clumsily flailing the mop around like a sword! He bumbles around the room, trips on a chair, and crashes into the kitchen table!
Ow! I hurt my leg! Captain Handsome hurt his leg! Mommmmmmmmmmm!
Voice
Oh, Hawkothy. Not again!
In present day, Hawk runs forward and tries to block the projector!
No!
It's too late. The crowd is pointing and laughing, taking pictures with their cell phones...
This is... Embarrassment! Hawk hasn't felt it in so long! It burrrrrrrrrns!
Hawk looks out and sees Colt and Tom by the projector!
You two! You did this! Bros! Get them!
Hawk and his remaining bros advance towards the projector. Tom and Colt glance at each other.
Uh oh. Time to book it?
My limo's in the lot! Go!
Tom and Colt sprint off! They race through the woods, hopping over logs and rocks! They rush around the lodge to its parking lot...
Where they find the first two bros waiting by the limo!
Hey! It's the two guys from the race!
Have you seen a bus full of cheerleaders?!
Hey! It's the guy who gave us the money!
We thought about it, and that's bribery!
Hawk and his two other bros arrive from behind! Tom and Colt are now surrounded!
No one humiliates the Hawk! No one!
Bestest brosies... Let's teach these two a lesson in pain!
And the lesson is that we beat them up!
Colt and Tom press back-to-back. Hawk and his bros advance, closing in...
You any good at fighting?
I'm okay.
Think we can take the five of them?
Only one way to find out!
`GET THEM!`
Hawk and his bros lunge forward...
Make your choice!
Fight!
Strike a bro!|Hit Hawk!|Punch a bro!
Strike Tom!|Hit Tom!|Punch Tom!|Get punched!
The bros rush forward towards the two guys! Colt winds up...
And accidentally punches Tom in the gut!
Ow! What the heck, man?!
Sorry! Sorry! I got confused! I...
Colt is cut off as a bro tackles him and slams him into the side of the limo!
Oooof!
Another bro grabs Tom and holds his arms. Hawk approaches, winding up a punch...
When the limo door pops open, and Jeeves hops out!
He weaves through the bros with a cat-like precision, hitting each with a series of lightning-fast jabs...
Aggh!
Oooof!
He leaves Hawk for last... And kicks him just once, right in the shins!
Hawk falls to the ground!
Ow! I hurt my leg! Hawk hurt his leg! Mommmmmmmmmmm!
Hawk's bros lift Hawk up! The five of them run off into the night!
Colt and Tom pull themselves up...
Are you okay, young sirs?
Yeah, I'm fine...
Me too... Man, where'd you learn to fight like that?
As a young man, I spent a year studying with Shaolin monks at a monastery deep in the mountains. It was jolly good fun.
I had so hoped you two would have handled the fight yourselves... A little fisticuffs is good for a young man's soul!
I gotta say, I'm liking this butler more and more...
Colt turns to Tom.
And you're not half-bad, either.
Heh!
Colt extends his hand, and Tom shakes it.
Colt and Tom are a perfectly coordinated fighting machine! Staying carefully back-to-back, they both throw a swift flurry of punches and kicks!
The first bro takes a jab to the chin! The second a kick to the shins! The third lands a lucky punch on Tom, but Colt sends him tumbling backward with a hard shove!
Hawk attack!
Hawk grabs Colt, holding his arms! The final bro punches Colt in the stomach...
But then Tom springs back up and swings his feet low, kicking out Hawk's feet from under him!
Hawk fall! `Hawk fall!`
Hawk slams to the ground!
Ow! I hurt my leg! Hawk hurt his leg! Mommmmmmmmmmm!
Hawk's bros pull him up! The five of them run off into the night.
Colt and Tom watch them go...
Then collapse together against a limo, laughing together!
That was `awesome!`
I can't believe I'm saying this... But honestly, Fancypants, you're not half bad.
Tom leans over and pats Colt on the shoulder.
You're not so bad yourself.
The window to the limo rolls down, revealing Jeeves in the passenger seat!
Not to intrude, but will you two be doing this for much longer?
Jeeves! You were here the whole time! Why didn't you help?!
Oh, I would have if things had gotten out of hand, but it looked like you two had it covered. Besides... A little fisticuffs is good for the soul!
I gotta say, I'm liking this butler more and more...
Tom and Colt stand up. Colt extends his hand, and Tom shakes it.
Look... Do you still want those snowboarding lessons? We'd have to stick to the bunny slopes in this light, but I could probably teach you a move or two...
Thanks... But no thanks. Pranking that guy and fighting his goons... I haven't done something that spontaneous and exciting in a while.
I spend so much time trying to be the best in everything... I forget how much fun it can be to actually take a risk!
Maybe that's why Kim wants me to go snowboarding with her in the first place... And you know,  I'm sure she'll still like me even if she sees me take an occasional tumble!
You know what? I think so too.
How about you? Are you going to stay out here?
Naw. You were right with what you said earlier... I was taking the coward's way out by running from my problems.
I need to get back to Centerscore... To face my issues head-on... And to learn to be a better person.
Besides... I don't really think I'm going to have much of a job here anymore. I `did` just publicly humiliate our big celebrity guest...
My gut says I should make a run for it... But no. That's what the old Colt would do. I guess I'll just go talk to the owner and explain myself...
And that's `my` cue to leave. Take care, Colt.
You too, Fancypants.
The next day, after being yelled at by the lodge owner for nearly two hours, Colt hits the road again... This time, headed back to Centerscore...
He bikes all day, thinking the whole time about what he'll say to Sam and Denni...
And stops to eat in a roadside diner just north of San Francisco...
He sits in a booth in the back, quietly enjoying his food...
When a tough young woman walks up to him.
Hey there.
Hey?
That your bike out front? The '99 Warhog?
Might be.
It's not bad... I like the chrome finish. They totally screwed up the design with the 2002 revamp.
You into bikes, huh?
I'm more into ninjas than choppers... But I can still appreciate a good American hog. Mind if I join you?
Make your choice!
Go ahead.|Yeah, I mind.
What do you say?
Fine. Suit yourself, tough guy.
She turns to walk away...
Aw jeez, what am I doing? I resolved to be better... But here I am again, shoving someone away just for trying to be nice!
Colt gets up and walks after the girl.
Wait... Hold on. Sorry. I'm a... I'm kind of going through some stuff right now.
The name's Colt.
She examines Colt skeptically.
I'm Monique. And that's my friend, Slade.
Monique jerks her head to the far side of the diner. A huge, tattooed man in his early 20s is playing pinball. He glowers in your direction.
Try anything funny, and he'll tear you in half.
Nothing funny, I promise. I just wanted... Not to be a jerk, I guess.
Well, I suppose I can understand that.
Colt and Monique sit down.
Thanks.
The girl slides down opposite Colt.
I'm Monique. That's my friend, Slade.
Monique jerks her head to the far side of the diner. A huge, tattooed man in his early 20s is playing pinball. He glowers in your direction.
Well, I'm Colt.
So... You running `to,` or you running `from?`
Excuse me?
Come on, don't play innocent. I've seen your type a dozen times before... Tough, jaded drifter with a sweet, sensitive side underneath...
So you are running to someone... Or away from them?
I was running from... Now I'm running to. Problem is, I'm not sure which `who` I'm running to.
Heh! Here's to that! Mind if I steal a fry?
Sure, go ahead. I was done with them, anyway.
So... Where are these someones that you might be running to?
Centerscore, California. It's a little place along the coast.
I love Centerscore! I used to stop there all the time! Awesome beaches, and some pretty cool parties...
Yeah?
Yeah. Listen, here's a thought... Why don't the three of us ride down together? It's a lonely highway and Slade's not exactly the best conversationalist.
We have to stop by San Francisco for a little business... But after that, I'd be totally game to ride with you the rest of the way.
Slade won't mind?
Colt glances back Slade's way...
Naw, don't worry about it! He looks tough, but he's a total softie.
Well... Okay, sure, why not? Company's always a good thing, right?
I couldn't agree more!
Meanwhile, in a crowded bullpen of a precinct of the San Francisco Police Department...
Detective Mal Fallon examines a chalkboard. Pinned to it are images of a number of crime scenes... And in the middle is a photo of Monique!
Monique Winchester. Wanted for at least fifteen counts of armed robbery, assault, and reckless endangerment.
And rumor has it, she's headed into San Francisco.
Mal closely examines the photo.
She should be considered armed... And `extremely` dangerous.
Whoa! Colt doesn't know it, but he's about to get into some `very` serious trouble!

What Happened To Colt, Part 1...
The Journey Begins...
Several months ago, Colt sits at his desk.
His bag is packed, and he's made up his mind to leave. There's just one last thing to do... The hardest thing he's ever done.
All right... Just got to write Sam a goodbye letter...
Never really written a letter before... But it can't be that bad, right? Madeline sends letters every Christmas, and she's nine!
He grabs a pen and stares down at a blank white paper.
Then again... She's saying 'Dear Santa, please bring me a pony...'. Not 'Goodbye forever...'
Gah... How do I even start this thing?
Make your choice!
Dear Sam.|Dearest Samantha.|Yo! Sambutt!
What do you say?
Nice and simple! Perfect!
'Dear Sam...'
'I have to admit, I really wish I didn't have to write this letter... But I just don't see any other way.'
'The truth is, I'm going to be skipping town for a while...'
'I don't know when I'll be back. To be honest, I don't know `if` I will be back.'
'I've been doing a lot of thinking lately, and I'm not happy with who I am... Or how I treated you.'
'I was wrong for you. I see that now. Kissing Denni was `seriously` not okay, and neither was acting like I was committed when I didn't mean it.'
'I know I'm not ready for a relationship with you, because I'm not ready for a relationship with anyone. I need to be alone... To figure myself out.'
'All my life, all I've done is hurt the people I love and care about. And I'm sick of it.'
'So I'm going to go off the grid for a while... Disappear, if you know what I mean.'
Make your choice!
I hope you understand.|I hope you can find it in your heart to forgive me.|I hope I don't get lice.
What do you say?
'If I could think of another way, I would... But I can't. I just can't go on hurting people.'
'Don't come looking for me. Don't try to find me. Just... Let me figure this out.'
'I'll miss you... Miss you more than you'll ever know... But this is the way it has to be.'
'Goodbye, Sammy.'
Now, I just gotta sign it...
Make your choice!
Love...|Sincerely...|Smell ya later!
What do you say?
Man... It's crazy to see that written out like that... But it's how I feel.
Colt signs his name, then steps back and rereads the letter.
Plain and simple, I just tell her how I feel. Can't get more honest than that.
Colt carefully puts the letter in an envelope and seals it.
I wonder if I should write one for Denni...
We're not really a `thing...` I mean, we just kissed once...
Naw, it's fine. She probably won't even miss me.
The door to the room swings open, and Colt's little sister Madeline runs in!
Watcha doin, Colt?
Hey, Maddie! You're home from school early!
The teacher fell and hit his head! When he woke up, he forgot how to talk!
Madeline peeks over Colt's shoulder.
Are you writing a letter? Who's it to? Is it a `loooove` letter?
No!
Is it to Santa? You should know, he never brings you what you ask for...
It's not to Santa. It's... Well, it's some adult stuff.
Ooooooooo...
Madeline looks over and spots Colt's backpack, stuffed with his clothes...
Are you going on a trip?
Colt kneels down, placing a hand on Madeline's shoulders.
Yeah, Maddy, I am. I'll be going away... For a little while.
Where are you going?
I don't really know.
When will you be back?
I don't know that either.
But...
Look, Maddie, I just have to go, okay? And I can't tell you much more than that.
Madeline starts to cry. Colt leans over and hugs her.
Hey... `Hey.` Don't cry, okay? It's okay! I'll come back.
Promise?
Promise. And a `real` promise, not like that deadbeat Santa.
Okay...
And look... If anything goes really wrong... If you need to reach me... Just call my cell. I promise I'll come running.
Colt hugs Madeline again.
I love you, Colt...
Love you too, Maddie.
Colt gets up, puts on a stoic face, and slings his backpack over his shoulder.
Okay then... No need to drag this out. Gotta just rip the bandage off...
Colt walks out the door, not looking back.
Soon enough, Colt is out on the open road. He drives through the countryside on his motorcycle.
The wind rushing through his hair is the only thing he feels...
And the rush of the engine drowns out the world.
After several hours, he's pulled out of his trance by the rumble of his stomach.
Gotta get something to eat...
Colt pulls over at a roadside diner and heads in. It's quiet and empty.
He grabs a table and flips open the menu. The diner's manager walks over.
What can I get you?
Let's see... I'll have the...
Make your choice!
Double Bacon Cheeseburger.|Red-hot Quesadilla, extra hot sauce.|Side salad.
What do you say?
Heh! That's our specialty!
Awesome! And give me a side-order of chili fries!
Oh, and do you have any mashed potatoes? I love mashed potatoes...
Some time later...
Colt leans back at his table, several empty plates laid out in front of him! He pats his stomach...
Oh yeah... `That` hit the spot...
Hungry, huh?
I've got an appetite...
The manager sets down the check.
Yeah, well, it ran you about 25 dollars.
Colt reaches into his pocket... And feels the lightness of his wallet.
Oh. Right.
See... The funny thing about money is...
I don't have any.
Well... That's a problem, isn't it?
I don't suppose I can work it off? Maybe wash some dishes? That's a thing, right?
Normally, I wouldn't even consider it...
But I might just offer a hand to a fellow Centerscore grad!
Huh? How'd you know I went to Centerscore?
You've got a Centerscore Lizards sticker on your bike!
Oh yeah... I think I put that there ironically...
I mean... Go Centerscore! Wooo!
Heh. Come five o'clock every day, the brick factory down by the river lets off. And those factory fellas get mighty hungry.
If you can wait tables for a couple hours... I'd consider our debt squared.
Sure! Sounds good to me!
And so, soon enough, factory workers begin trickling in. Colt stands at the far end of the room...
Heh! Joke's on the manager! This is gonna be a piece of cake!
Colt walks over to the first table, where a burly miner sits.
What can I get you?
